title: The build-and-upload workflow runs on every merge to main and records the version id
iWant: the CI run for the merge to surface the uploaded version id and both preview URLs
soThat: I can reach the preview surface and reference the version id without hunting

acceptanceCriteria.description: The `build-and-upload` workflow triggers on `push` to the `main` branch (and on the project's chosen linear-history proxy for merges), and does not trigger on `pull_request` or any other event.
acceptanceCriteria.then: the trigger set contains `push` scoped to the `main` branch (or the equivalent linear-history proxy); it contains no `pull_request` or `schedule` trigger

acceptanceCriteria.description: A successful run writes the uploaded version id, the version-id URL, and the preview alias URL to a structured output the `promote` workflow's `resolveNewestOfMain` path can read.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a successful `build-and-upload` run on a merge to main
acceptanceCriteria.when: the run's outputs are inspected after completion
acceptanceCriteria.then: a structured output object exists whose fields include `versionId`, `versionIdUrl`, and `previewAliasUrl`; every field is populated with a non-empty string; the `previewAliasUrl` host segment carries the operator-chosen alias string

acceptanceCriteria.description: The workflow authenticates to the vendor through named CI secrets (a vendor API token and a vendor account id) scoped to the Worker's account; neither secret ever appears in any log line.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a `build-and-upload` run that reads the vendor API token and account id from named CI secrets
acceptanceCriteria.when: the run's captured logs are inspected byte-for-byte
acceptanceCriteria.then: no log line contains the API token bytes; no log line contains the account id bytes; both are populated only into the vendor CLI's environment and redacted from any emitted line
